segments.text:
V. 36.
And one of the Phariſees aſked him to eat with him—Let the Candour with which our LORD accepted this •ivitation, and his Gentleneſs and Prudence at this enſuaring Entertainment, teach us to mingle the Wiſdom of the Serpent, with the Innocence and Sweetneſs of the Dove. Let us neither abſolutely refuſe all Favours nor reſent all Neglects, from thoſe whoſe Friendſhip is at beſt very doubtful, and their Intimacy by no means ſafe.
